lines.en: Well, one of the funner things that we do here in Pawnee is the annual Easter Egg Hunt.
Tom hides the eggs, and I have to say he did an exceptional job this year.
I've been searching for 25 minutes and I haven't found a single egg, and I'm an adult.
Oh, yeah, I forgot to do that.
Maybe Tom's trying to make this year a challenge, and if so, he's succeeding.
I don't think a single egg has been found yet. Let's keep looking. We're gonna find one.
